verdict.rationale: Google Drive has a well-documented official REST API and developer docs covering uploads, sharing, permissions, properties, push notifications, and even AI agent add-on integration with ADK/Vertex AI (google-drive-docs-4,5,9,10,11), which supports building AI-native integrations. However, there's no evidence of modern AI-native SDK conventions like an llms.txt or discoverable OpenAPI spec (both probes 404), and no client-library-specific SDK documentation (e.g., Python/Node SDK for agents) is cited beyond generic REST API references. Missing for 10: llms.txt/AI-discoverable spec, dedicated official SDK packages beyond REST API docs, independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK ease-of-use.
